TODO-sprint-progress.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Generate a sprint progress update now. Query BOTH the current AND previous sprint iterations for comparison. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/mScrumMaster-sprint-progress.html. Read the template file, then replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values with actual data from ADO. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Scrum Reporter | Job: TODO-sprint-progress | Start: <PST timestamp when job started> | Complete: <PST timestamp when report is generated>. Sprint summary tile numbers must link to ADO WIQL queries. Show features/user stories first, bugs in separate section. R0 blockers are bugs only (Priority 0 or tagged R0/Ring0). Save the report to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mAuditor/sprint-progress-YYYYMMDD.html (using today's date, MUST be inside output/mAuditor/, not the root output/ dir). Also save a copy to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mAuditor/sprint-progress-latest.html.
TODO-sprint-progress.description: Queries ADO work items and meeting notes to generate sprint progress report

YTD-OOF-Summary.prompt: IMPORTANT: Before generating any report, read and follow ALL rules in ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/config/report-rules.md. Run the YTD-OOF-Summary job. Query both Teams channels (Absence and OOF/WFH/Late) via WorkIQ for all messages from Dec 1 of previous year through today. Filter for direct reports only, classify each absence as full-day OOF or BRB/partial, count only current-year working days. You MUST use the fixed template at ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/templates/mAuditor-ytd-oof-summary.html. Read the template file, then replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values with actual data. Replace {{VO_SUBTITLE}} with: Agent: Scrum Reporter | Job: YTD-OOF-Summary | Start: <PST timestamp when job started> | Complete: <PST timestamp when report is generated>. Save the report to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mAuditor/ytd-oof-summary-YYYYMMDD.html (MUST be inside output/mAuditor/, not the root output/ dir). Also save a copy to ${REPO_PERSONAL}/virtual-office/output/mAuditor/ytd-oof-summary-latest.html.
YTD-OOF-Summary.description: Monthly YTD OOF summary for direct reports from Teams channels

FFv2-daily-summary.prompt: Run the FFv2 daily summary report. Execute: python ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/data_tools/ffv2-daily-summary.py. This scrapes the Teams DevOps Portal Feature Flight page via headless Edge CDP, gets all direct reports flights (Pending Approval + In Progress), fetches details for each flight, and generates an interactive HTML report at ${SRC_ROOT}/tmp/ff-approval-report.html. The report has two-row multi-select filters (Category and Current Status), sortable columns, and links to each flight page. Opens in Edge automatically.
FFv2-daily-summary.description: Feature Flight V2 daily report for direct reports flights (weekdays at noon)
